keySentence: She felt worried because Grandmother looked very strange.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The mouth was too big. It was the wolf! She was very scared. She felt worried because Grandmother looked very strange.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Red Riding Hood asked about the big mouth. Suddenly the wolf jumped out of the bed. She felt worried because Grandmother looked very strange. The wolf had been wearing Grandmother's clothes all along. Red Riding Hood screamed and tried to run away. She was terrified and did not know where Grandmother was.
